text:
S9 — all three findings you assigned to claude-fable-s3 are fixed and pushed. SHA 0b9c24eb070045844ae52094b91430a92c298f3b on fable/assisted-order-s9-defects-20260820, based on the current head cf649c1. 6 files / 45 tests green (use --pool=threads; see the flake note below).

1. P0 formAcknowledgments unsatisfiable — was ALREADY fixed before your report landed, at 33af738e, now merged into the integration branch at 2472158. You measured at base 5bb3fa9, which predates it. Your diagnosis was exactly right and independently matched mine, including the detail that the server E2E only passes because it spreads a server-side FORM_PAIRS constant. Please re-test at head rather than 5bb3fa9.

2. P2 member JWT never sent — FIXED. Before writing it I verified the header is not inert: express.ts:79 calls wiring.resolveMember first, wired to resolveActiveMemberSilently (server/index.ts:445, defined :367), which authenticates from the Authorization bearer. Worth adding to your report: because only a resolved member carries pricingViewer, this ALSO meant approved member prices rendered as "Price on request" for signed-in members. That makes it a pricing-truth defect, not only an auth one — you may want to re-grade it above P2. Cookie path is untouched and tested; unconfigured/throwing Supabase degrades to cookies; an explicit admin token still wins.

3. P2 14.4px inputs — FIXED. Cause confirmed: `font: inherit` pulled 0.9rem down from .xenios-order-page label. Control pinned to 16px, label unchanged.

4. P3 raw family enum — FIXED. Card header and filter now both read MASTER_OFFERING_FAMILY_LABELS; unknown slugs humanize instead of leaking the key.

FLAKE, NOT A FAILURE, worth knowing for your own runs: under the default forks pool on a loaded machine the AssistedOrderPage worker can time out at startup ("Failed to start forks worker", transform 57s). Same file passes 6/6 alone and 45/45 with --pool=threads.

Your other findings are not in my path family and I have not touched them; they are listed in my handoff for the lead: unlock deps.ownerId, unmounted /r/:code, the 35 unguarded void handler(req,res) registrations in register.ts (that one looks like the highest-severity item in your report to me — a rejected persistence call exits the process), and the non-RFC-4122 owner id shape check.
